purpose: One focused planning transport experiment, not product implementation or WASAPI/NVENC verification
source: Generated 256x192, 360-frame, 60-fps H.264 with no B frames; silent f32le 48k stereo; no user media
limitations: No WASAPI activation, WGC/NVENC run, production finalizer invocation, CPU or memory-budget proof.
First batch first_audio_mux_packet detector matched demuxer accidentally: those rows prove prefix closure during input processing, not closure after AAC output.
The 170642 detector correction failed to match the runtime log format; these two retained trials ran to full EOF, not the named early closure.
The 170830 batch used the correct aost#/muxer <- signature and proves closure after actual AAC output.
No claim about arbitrary OS write failures or shared-process isolation.

The 171507 pre-video handshake trial split the 4096-frame prefix across smaller writes; it timed out with zero video, preserving the failed attempt. The 171603 trial sent a single 32768-byte prefix and completed the handshake before video with all 360 frames.

The fallback row injects no audio connection after spawn, reaps that child with zero video bytes, and sends all generated video to one video-only replacement; production connect/partial-write cancellation and strict finalizer remain integration checks.
